runtime_floors.comment: Runtime security floors for policy devsecops.runtime_version (gate 11). One entry per runtime: the Dockerfile image names that declare it, the advisory the floor answers, and the minimum fixed version per supported branch. To add a floor or a runtime, edit THIS DATA FILE only — neither the policy nor the gate changes. Branches not listed here and older than the lowest listed branch have no entry on purpose: the policy denies them as end-of-life lines with no fixed upstream release (distro backports are deliberately NOT guessed — a workload relying on a backport must pin and evidence it out of band).
runtime_floors.source: PHP2Shell: PHP security advisories for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (disclosed 2026-10-20, fixed releases published 2026-10-21); CISA KEV catalog 2026.10.21 (neither CVE listed yet — this floor check deliberately does not depend on KEV membership).
